scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the expected coefficients A and B from the provided ion data (inline), then compares the agent's fitted constants to these recomputed values. This verifies the regression was performed correctly.

hidden_assets.purpose: Inline ion data (Hepler 1957 Table I) used to recompute the gold coefficients A and B.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Hepler 1957 Table I, transcribed from the paper markdown.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually transcribed from the published table in the paper; no synthetic data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Data is a direct transcription of the published experimental compilation and is required to independently verify the regression.

outputs.description: Coefficients A and B of the partial molal volume equation (V = A·r³ − B·z²/r) for cations and anions, obtained by linear regression of V/r³ against z²/r⁴ on the provided ion data.

output_contract.notes: The ion data table is provided as a resource; the agent does not need to compile it from the literature. The fitted constants are compared against hidden reference values with appropriate tolerances.
